dimensions.label: Clicks Target Extension
dimensions.name: clicks.target_extension
dimensions.sql:
CASE
        WHEN SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(${TABLE}.target_url, '?', 1), '#', 1), '(.aspx)$'), ${target_urlhost}, 2) LIKE '%.%'
        THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(${TABLE}.target_url, '?', 1), '#', 1), '(.aspx)$'), ${target_urlhost}, 2), '([^\.]+$)')
        ELSE NULL
      END

A Download click shows the count that users have clicked to download an asset linked to on your page.

The asset is a file type that is likely to be downloaded versus being viewed in a browser. Example assets include: .pdf, .xls, .xlsx, .doc, .docx, .ppt, etc.

dashboard_elements.body_text:
Glossary of Terms: Definitions for standard results can be found in the online guide's glossary. Definitions for all results featured here can also be found by hovering over the "i" icon.
Filter - Target URL: Input the URL or URLs of the asset link or links to view results for specific assets.
Filter - Page URL: Input the page URL or URLs to view results for a specific page or pages. This page or pages is where the asset link(s) are featured on.
Filter - Referral Domain: Input the site domain URL of the referral domain which you want to view results for.
Filter - Referral URL: Input the page URL of the referral page URL which you want to view results for.
View or Download More Rows/Columns of Data: To view or download more rows/columns of data, use the "Advanced data options" of the "Download Data" option. Go to the online guide for instructions.
